basic_info.description: Russian Hill Elegance with San Francisco Charm! This light and bright top-level full-floor Edwardian condo in a 2 unit building has a rare 41 foot width, high ceilings with coves & crown moldings and beautiful hardwood floors throughout. 3 bedrooms, 2 full baths. Spacious living room/dining room with fireplace and large windows allows abundant natural light. Chef's Eat-In-Kitchen w/ Wolf 6 burner range, new KitchenAid appliances, microwave, refrigerator (w/ ice maker & water dispenser), wall oven & dishwasher with designer counter & backsplash. A door provides easy access to the rear garden. A Laundry room off the kitchen doubles as a pantry. Two renovated bathrooms feature radiant floor heating, Waterworks bath fixtures, a deep soaking tub, Porcelanosa double sink vanity and faucet, and Toto bidet. New roof 02/2024. Large private storage/wine cellar & another storage. Oversized garage w Tesla Wall Charger & private driveway. Low $300/mo HOA. 98 walk score.
